answer: Operator-Bound Credential Vine: each wallet credential embeds an operator fingerprint and chains to that operator’s signed lantern beacon, refreshed per epoch. All credentials under one operator share a single issuance-rate budget and form a vine. A sybil burst—many new credentials in one epoch—raises an anomaly signal at the beacon root; the root is invalidated, quarantining every descendant wallet and multiplying the operator’s next-epoch issuance delay. Cost: one attempt freezes the attacker’s whole fleet and throttles the operator’s future wallet creation, not just the offending wallet.
